Card Q&A.a: Yes. Digimon in breeding areas aren’t counted by the effect, so this Digimon can attack.
Card Q&A.q: If my opponent has a Digimon with digivolution cards in their breeding area, can this Digimon attack?
Does this card’s inherited effect activate when my opponent activates ?

Effect: ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
[Your Turn] While your opponent has a Digimon with a digivolution card in play, this Digimon can't attack.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When a digivolution card of an opponent's Digimon is trashed, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to its owner's hand.
